knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says to search, record the missing product with the job and time, and report it, because a missing hazardous product may be a safety issue. Assuming it was used up (option 0) and replacing it without a record (option 2) both hide the loss.

The lesson requires a written handover with the state of each item, any damage or leak, and the receiver's confirmation. A total count alone (option 0) and the time (option 2) do not record the state of the kit.
The reconcile section says to check the kit against the job map and the stock register at the end of a job.

practicalCriteria: Learner reconciles a supplied kit against a job map and stock register at the end of a simulated job, and accounts for every item.
Learner completes a written handover that gives the state of each item and any damage or leak.
Learner records a simulated missing product with the item, quantity, time, job and likely cause, and reports it.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Kit reconciliation record with count, state and any discrepancy
Loss or damage record with cause and action taken
stopWorkCriteria: Learner leaves a kit unreconciled in a vehicle
Learner hides a missing hazardous product
